description: Lists every game of the active developer account (read-only, needs login): slug, title, status (draft, live, unlisted, banned), live version id and cover/thumbnail URLs. Use it to find the slug the other tools take, or to check that a game exists before gamealia_create_game; for one game's versions and review state use gamealia_get_status.
name: gamealia_list_games
title: List my games
